title: DALLE-URBAN: Capturing the urban design expertise of large text to image transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitatively evaluating generated images prompted with specific cities and countries to observe the model's tendency to default to Western, urban architectural styles and scenes.

Visually inspecting generated natural and built environment scenes to identify a consistent overrepresentation of sunny weather and blue skies, even when prompting for geographic locales traditionally known for snowy climates.

Prompting the model with descriptive urban qualities (e.g., 'safe', 'unsafe', 'healthy', 'unhealthy') and visually analyzing the physical and socioeconomic characteristics (e.g., fresh paint, construction quality, greenery vs. pollution) the model associates with these terms.
